content:
OWNER DECISION

Question 1:
Choose A — rename the existing repository in place.

Rename:

ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest

to:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Requirements:

- Preserve full Git history.
- Preserve all branches.
- Preserve all tags.
- Preserve issues and settings.
- Verify the GitHub redirect.
- Verify Render still points to the renamed repository.
- Verify auto-deploy still works.
- Verify GitHub main HEAD is unchanged.
- Verify /health and /version after the rename.
- Do not create a duplicate repository unless renaming fails.

Question 2:
Choose A — complete everything you can from this environment.

Proceed with:

- Code cleanup
- Removal of orphaned Rork references
- IVX-controlled build scripts
- GitHub Actions preparation
- Dependency audit
- AI-provider audit
- Render/GitHub read-only verification
- Clean production checks
- Exact manual-action list for anything requiring my account access

Do not pause again for high-level planning.

For anything you cannot execute because of account permissions, return:

MANUAL OWNER ACTION REQUIRED

with:

- Exact platform
- Exact screen
- Exact button
- Exact value or setting
- Expected result
- Verification step

After the repository rename, verify:

- Repository URL
- Repository owner
- Default branch
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Render repository binding
- Render deployment status
- API /health
- API /version
- Worker heartbeat
- Website HTTP 200

Final target:

- Primary repository name contains no “rork”
- IVX owns the repository
- Render deploys from the IVX repository
- No active Rork API, SDK, package, build dependency, or runtime dependency remains
- IVX Senior Developer works without Rork
